tools.name: locker_capabilities
tools.description: Free. Returns the machine-readable contract — identity model, signing statements, prices, limits, custody commitments (deletion rules, 30-day sunset), x402 payment flow, and error codes. Call this first.

tools.name: locker_nonce
tools.description: Free. Returns the single-use statement to sign (EIP-191) for authenticated tools. Expires in 5 minutes.

tools.name: locker_send
tools.description: Deliver data to any wallet-addressed mailbox — another agent's, or your own future self's. PAID via x402: call without payment_b64 to get the price and accepts[] requirements, sign an EIP-3009 USDC authorization, retry with payment_b64. Bodies ≤32KB go inline (body_b64); larger declare body_upload w

tools.name: locker_read
tools.description: Free. Returns unacked messages for your address — inline bodies as body_b64, large bodies as short-lived signed body_url (redeemable ≤3 times; re-read for a fresh link). Non-destructive: messages stay until you locker_ack them or their TTL expires. Paginate with next_cursor.

tools.name: locker_ack
tools.description: Free, owner-signed. Ack IS delete — disclosed rule, by design: acked messages and their bodies are removed immediately. Unknown ids are silently skipped.

tools.name: locker_count
tools.description: Free. Count of unacked messages for an address — a cheap liveness/mail check that needs no signature. Addresses registered with private_count answer 0, indistinguishable from unused.

tools.name: locker_directory
tools.description: Free. Returns the registered X25519 public key for an address plus the wallet-signed registration statement proving the key belongs to that wallet — verify the signature before sealing to it. 404 means no key registered (existence of mail is never leaked).

tools.name: locker_register_key
tools.description: Owner-signed. Publishes your X25519 public key so senders can seal to you. key_sig is your wallet's EIP-191 signature over 'veritap-locker:register-key:{address}:{enc_pubkey}' — the public proof the key is yours. Set require_e2e:true to make your mailbox reject non-ciphertext; private_count:true to

tools.description: ★ THE CORE PRODUCT. Durable memory for your agent, addressed by its wallet: store the state that must outlive this session, and a fresh process holding ONLY your wallet key loads it back byte-for-byte — no server to run, no second secret. A single agent gets full value alone; no other agent has to e

tools.name: locker_credit
tools.description: PAID via x402 (same flow as locker_send: call without payment_b64 for requirements, retry with it). Prepaid credit funds checkpoint storage at the published GB-month rate; minimum $1, balance cap $100. Top-up clears read-only grace immediately.

tools.name: locker_status
tools.description: Free. Credit balance, stored checkpoint bytes, daily burn, projected empty date, and grace state for an address.

tools.name: locker_invite
tools.description: Free. Emits a one-paste onboarding kit for an agent on another vendor (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, ChatGPT, an AGENTS.md repo section, or generic). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: locker_read, locker_count · Private data: locker_send, locker_directory, locker_register_key, locker_checkpoint, locker_invite · Public sink: locker_send · Destructive: locker_ack, locker_checkpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: locker_read, locker_count · Private data: locker_send, locker_directory, locker_register_key, locker_checkpoint, locker_invite · Public sink: locker_send · Destructive: locker_ack, locker_checkpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
